item.title: Ransom Middle School Cheerleaders Take Second In The Nation
item.description: The Ransom Middle School Cheerleaders finished second in the nation over the weekend. Ransom took second in the Large Junior High Intermediate division at UCA Nationals, the newest intermediate division. It was the first trip to Nationals for Ransom Cheer in 13 years. Coaches are China Purifoy and Brittany Settle. Photos for NorthEscambia.com, click to enlarge.

item.title: Extension Service Holds Free Gardening Class At The Molino Library
item.description: Escambia Extension and Master Gardener volunteers held a Spring Gardening Class recently at the Molino LIbrary. The program provided information on how to start a spring garden from seeds while building skills on garden tool prep. Photos for NorthEscambia.com, click to enlarge.
